ns2:section.sectionText: This course will prepare students for an international learning exchange with travel to Cape Town, South Africa. The course will cover expectations, preparing students culturally and logistically, and assisting student with articulating their experience for future personal and professional goals. Student must not only register for the course, but apply for the Study Abroad program found at https://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/index.cfm?FuseAction=Programs.ViewProgramAngular&id=11866 This course will include travel to Cape Town, South Africa - January 1 - 14, 2023. This course is open to AE, ECE, MechSE, ISE, NPRE, and Engineering Undeclared Students. Estimated Cost $4600
